alice: Heads-up: scheduling the tenant-index compact backfill for tonight's 23:30 UTC change window. We'll pin service to v2.3.2 during the operation to avoid schema/model mismatches. Need a clear stop/rollback plan if we see lock pressure.
ben: How disruptive is the DDL step? any exclusive lock expectations?
sasha: DDL swap is quick (~150-400ms). The risky bit is the backfill touching ~18M rows across 40 shards. Plan: micro-batches, dynamic rate cap, and a 10m pre-window canary drain (route 15% to canary) to surface tail latencies. Abort triggers: >5s avg lock wait sustained for 4 shards within a 10m window OR deadlock_count >= 2 in 15m.
deploybot: Migration job created by alice at 2026-03-23T21:45:02Z. Job ID: mig-20260323-tnidx-02. Config: stagger=100, batch_size=120, rate_limit=900r/s, dynamic_throttle=true. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/migrations/tnidx-compact-backfill
```bash
# start (dry-run first)
./deploybot schedule --id mig-20260323-tnidx-02 --start 2026-03-23T23:30:00Z --stagger 100 --batch 120 --rate 900
```
tim: Add explicit emergency stop command to pager runbook: `/deploybot stop-migration mig-20260323-tnidx-02 --reason "lock-pressure"`. Also recommend infra has DB replicas on standby to promote if primary struggles.
infra-bot: Quick note: 3% of production p99 latency correlates with previous backfills during peak hour. We'll enable the canary drain at 23:20 UTC for 10m and run a quick synthetics check. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/tnidx/overview
ben: Add to release notes: "Tenant-index compact backfill (v2.3.2 pinned). Expect controlled latency increase; non-critical writes may see transient errors."
alice: I'll update release notes and pin the deploy. Sasha, please own monitoring during the run and escalate to ops if abort triggers hit.
sasha: On it. I'll maintain live notes in the runbook and will call abort if deadlock_count >=2 OR if write-error-rate >0.8% for 5 minutes.
ben: Suggest we reduce batch_size to 100 to be conservative. Lower throughput but safer.
alice: Agreed. Update job config to batch_size=100. deploybot, apply change.
deploybot: Job mig-20260323-tnidx-02 updated: batch_size=100, stagger=100, rate_limit=900. Scheduled start 2026-03-23T23:30:00Z. Will attempt migration lock acquisition at start.
infra-bot: Canary drain job scheduled at 2026-03-23T23:20:00Z -> route 15% to canary for 10m. Synthetics and DB health checks will run at +2m and +7m. Oncall: @sasha @tim please acknowledge.
tim: Acknowledged. I'll be oncall and reachable.
alice: Final preflight checklist: pin to v2.3.2, release notes updated, emergency stop command added to pager, canary drain scheduled, abort triggers documented (lock wait and deadlocks). If no objections we proceed.
sasha: No objections. Ready to proceed and will post live status updates in this thread. :rocket:
deploybot: Reminder: keep https://confluence.redwood/migrations/tnidx-compact-backfill open. If `/deploybot stop-migration` is issued, deploybot will pause backfills, roll back the online swap if in-flight, and mark the job aborted in CI.
